title: Iran says it struck a US radar in Bahrain, the US military denies it
caption:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain after a strike on southern Iran; US Central Command says two Iranian drones were shot down, with no injuries or damage. Iran also says an LNG tanker hit a mine in the Strait of Hormuz. President Trump says the US controls the strait and would not hesitate to use force again.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
